title: Vectors: OSCORE-protected LCI exchanges
description: Acceptance: test vectors for OSCORE LCI
close_reason: Needs design decision: Creating new OSCORE-protected LCI exchange test vectors requires designing: (1) which LCI resources need coverage, (2) vector format combining OSCORE protection with LCI CoAP operations, (3) coordination with sibling implementation beads (Python/Rust/Zephyr OSCORE over local link).
